data.core: Prepared business collaboration with explicit value for both parties
state_rules: No automatic transition to mutual_interest for another party
terms_agreed requires both current revision acceptances
Consent revocation blocks new dependent actions without silently erasing legal records

requirements.requirement: Explicit capabilities, current needs, desired result, availability and allowed collaboration modes
requirements.acceptance: Old profile imports remain valid; new fields default private/unconfirmed.

requirements.requirement: Extend existing matcher for exchange, paid_service, referral, hybrid
requirements.acceptance: Both parties allow mode and have current availability. Exchange requires bilateral skill fit; paid_service requires explicit compensation interest on both sides; referral requires agreed referral scheme and third-party contact consent; hybrid validates each component; joint_project requires shared outcome and contributions. Positive and negative cases for each mode.

requirements.requirement: Both participants independently confirm current interest
requirements.acceptance: One-sided click cannot confirm the other party; revocation closes consent-dependent actions.

requirements.requirement: Immutable revisions of proposed collaboration terms
requirements.acceptance: Both accept identical revision/hash. Any change to agreed content including scope, price, deadlines, acceptance, IP, confidentiality or termination resets both acceptances; cosmetic UI outside agreed content does not. Retention is separately governed.

requirements.requirement: Scope, out-of-scope, deadlines, compensation, acceptance, IP, termination
requirements.acceptance: Missing required terms cannot become agreed; no guessed financial values.

requirements.requirement: Service-specific evidence with owner, source, scope, date and status
requirements.acceptance: Track provenance, verification and freshness separately; expiry never erases historic evidence or implies low competence. Expired eligibility blocks current regulated expert dispatch where required.

requirements.requirement: Qualified expert reviews consented fact pack for a specific subject
requirements.acceptance: Check subject competence, jurisdiction, current evidence, conflicts and referral fees before dispatch; license only where applicable. No eligible expert means pending, no arbitrary substitution.

requirements.requirement: Record submitted trial output and recipient decision
requirements.acceptance: Submission alone is not acceptance; dispute is represented without automatic guilt.

requirements.requirement: Immediate and optional delayed outcome feedback
requirements.acceptance: No reply is missing data; not negative competence or automatic credit penalty.

requirements.requirement: Granular consent, purpose, access, retention and export
requirements.acceptance: Hidden profiles remain undiscoverable; revocation prevents new model dispatch; retention policy covers derived data.

requirements.requirement: Reuse canonical adapter, schema validation and source attribution
requirements.acceptance: Untrusted profile text cannot authorize actions; output never invents skills, price or legal conclusions.

requirements.requirement: Draft introduction and schedule via existing flow
requirements.acceptance: No message or recording without explicit user action and appropriate participant consent.

requirements.requirement: Measure variable cost per useful outcome before billing
requirements.acceptance: Unknown cost stays unknown; paid tier cannot buy a higher competence score.

requirements.requirement: Fixed denominator funnel with missing-data and repeated-participant tracking
requirements.acceptance: Predeclare cohort, observation period, fixed denominators, decision thresholds and baseline. Suggested operational pilot: 10 disjoint pairs, 14 days, 5 mutually agreed briefs and 3 accepted trials; these are proposals, not observed demand. Track repeated participants, response rate, willingness to pay and support costs; no causal AI claim from nonrandom comparisons.
Old exports round-trip; permissions and deletions preserved; no second durable store.

requirements.requirement: Explicit state when suitable candidate is absent
requirements.acceptance: No fabricated participants or AI-generated evidence; invite a real colleague through authorized flow.
